ac_current_phase_a.description: AC line current, phase A. The trailing letter is the phase designator, not a unit.

ac_current_phase_b.description: AC line current, phase B. The trailing letter is the phase designator, not a unit.

ac_current_phase_c.description: AC line current, phase C. The trailing letter is the phase designator, not a unit.

ac_voltage_phase_a.description: Phase-to-neutral AC voltage, phase A. Distinct from line-to-line: on a 480 V wye system this reads 277 V.

ac_voltage_phase_b.description: Phase-to-neutral AC voltage, phase B. Distinct from line-to-line: on a 480 V wye system this reads 277 V.

ac_voltage_phase_c.description: Phase-to-neutral AC voltage, phase C. Distinct from line-to-line: on a 480 V wye system this reads 277 V.

active_power_kw.description: Total AC active power. Signed: export is negative.

ambient_temperature_c.description: Outdoor ambient air temperature. ADDED: no requested field holds the weather station's ambient reading.

amr.battery.charge_current_a.description: Charger current into the pack. Positive when charging.

amr.distance_to_target_m.description: Remaining distance to the current target.

amr.duty_cycles.description: Robot duty cycles. NOT battery charge cycles -- see charge_cycles.

apparent_power_kva.description: Total AC apparent power in kilovolt-amperes.

apparent_power_va.description: Total AC apparent power in volt-amperes. Apparent power is not active power: S = sqrt(P^2 + Q^2).

battery_capacity_kwh.description: Battery nameplate usable capacity. ADDED: Pack_Energy_Wh is a rating, not cumulative production; mapping it to energy_delivered_kwh would be a category error.

battery_cell_temp_max_c.description: Hottest cell temperature in the pack. ADDED: the Tesla BESS reports Cell_Temp_Max and no requested field holds it.

battery_current_a.bounds_note: signed: negative current is a battery DISCHARGING. Every BMS reports it that way, so a unidirectional floor of 0 deletes the normal night-time state of an off-grid system.
battery_current_a.description: Battery current. Positive charging, negative discharging.

battery_soc_pct.description: Battery state of charge, percent of usable capacity.

battery_soh_pct.description: Battery state of health, percent of original capacity.

cnc.spindle.rotary_velocity.bounds_note: signed: an M04 reverse spindle legitimately reports negative rpm on Fanuc/Haas/Siemens controllers, so the floor is negative rather than 0

dc_power_w.description: DC input power. Not inverter AC output — the difference between them is conversion loss.

dpf_soot_load_pct.description: Diesel particulate filter soot load. SPN 3719.

engine_hours.description: Total engine running hours. SPN 247. NOT idle hours -- see idle_hours; collapsing the two reported a 14,203-hour truck as 2,400.

engine_speed_rpm.bounds_note: signed: an M04 reverse spindle legitimately reports negative rpm on Fanuc/Haas/Siemens controllers, so the floor is negative rather than 0

inverter_heatsink_temp_c.description: Inverter heatsink temperature (SunSpec TmpSnk). Distinct from cabinet temperature: the heatsink runs hotter and is the thermal-derate trigger.

inverter_state_vendor.description: Vendor-defined inverter operating state (SunSpec StVnd). Not the standard St enum — the same integer means different things per vendor.

motors.drive.temperature.description: Motor temperature, drive position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.fl.temperature.description: Motor temperature, fl position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.fr.temperature.description: Motor temperature, fr position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.left.temperature.description: Motor temperature, left position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.lift.temperature.description: Motor temperature, lift position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.right.temperature.description: Motor temperature, right position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.rl.temperature.description: Motor temperature, rl position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.rr.temperature.description: Motor temperature, rr position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

motors.steer.temperature.description: Motor temperature, steer position. The position is part of the field name on purpose: a hot motor is only actionable if you know which one.

peak_demand_kw.description: Peak demand over the billing interval.

power_factor.description: Displacement power factor. Signed by convention.

relative_humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity. Present in the corpus dictionary and targeted by the carrier and generic_iot packs but absent from the registry until now.

robot.joint.0.drive_temperature.description: Joint 0 servo drive (amplifier) temperature. Distinct from the motor winding temperature -- different component, different limits.

robot.joint.0.position.description: Joint 0 angular position. Degrees; radians on the wire are converted.

robot.joint.1.drive_temperature.description: Joint 1 servo drive (amplifier) temperature. Distinct from the motor winding temperature -- different component, different limits.

robot.joint.1.position.description: Joint 1 angular position. Degrees; radians on the wire are converted.

robot.joint.2.drive_temperature.description: Joint 2 servo drive (amplifier) temperature. Distinct from the motor winding temperature -- different component, different limits.

robot.joint.2.position.description: Joint 2 angular position. Degrees; radians on the wire are converted.

robot.joint.3.drive_temperature.description: Joint 3 servo drive (amplifier) temperature. Distinct from the motor winding temperature -- different component, different limits.

robot.joint.3.position.description: Joint 3 angular position. Degrees; radians on the wire are converted.

robot.joint.4.drive_temperature.description: Joint 4 servo drive (amplifier) temperature. Distinct from the motor winding temperature -- different component, different limits.

robot.joint.4.position.description: Joint 4 angular position. Degrees; radians on the wire are converted.

robot.joint.5.drive_temperature.description: Joint 5 servo drive (amplifier) temperature. Distinct from the motor winding temperature -- different component, different limits.

robot.joint.5.position.description: Joint 5 angular position. Degrees; radians on the wire are converted.

robot.operating_mode.description: Controller operating mode (KUKA AUT/T1/T2, ABB AUTO/MANUAL).

robot.tcp.force_x.description: Tool centre point force along X.

robot.tcp.force_y.description: Tool centre point force along Y.

robot.tcp.force_z.description: Tool centre point force along Z.

robot.tcp.orientation_rx.description: Tool centre point orientation about X.

robot.tcp.orientation_ry.description: Tool centre point orientation about Y.

robot.tcp.orientation_rz.description: Tool centre point orientation about Z.

note: Authoritative canonical vocabulary AND unit contract. The LLM mapper may only emit a key from `fields`; anything else is rejected as a hallucination and recorded as UNRESOLVED. Energy vertical added 2026-08-22: 27 fields (battery, inverter, power meter, weather).
